# Key Findings (auto-generated)

Factual rollup of the current feature dataset. Interpretation lives in the final report.

## Overview
- Posts: 57,227 across 2 platforms (youtube: 49,896, instagram: 7,331).
- Content date range: 2016-04-20 to 2026-10-11.

## Sentiment by platform (English)
- instagram: positive 85.1%, neutral 7.7%, negative 7.3%.
- youtube: positive 61.4%, neutral 21.9%, negative 16.7%.

## Engagement vs sentiment
- Avg engagement percentile by sentiment: negative 0.488, neutral 0.496, positive 0.506 (spread 0.018).
- Relationship is essentially flat (sentiment does not predict engagement).

## Dominant topics (by volume)
- T4: time, agent, new, think - 35,050 posts.
- T0: business, help, build, right - 7,517 posts.
- T3: course, hi, step, pls - 1,561 posts.
- T2: free, free praise, praise, paid - 1,227 posts.
- T6: smart, explaining, crisp, explaining necessary - 1,196 posts.

## Emerging vs declining topics (recent vs earlier in window)
- Rising: T4: time, agent, new, think (+3.89 pts).
- Rising: T5: chat, gpt, chat gpt, claude (+0.26 pts).
- Rising: T2: free, free praise, praise, paid (-0.0 pts).
- Declining: T0: business, help, build, right (-1.3 pts).
- Declining: T3: course, hi, step, pls (-1.38 pts).

## Top keywords (by volume)
- ChatGPT - 11,582 posts.
- AI Agents - 9,510 posts.
- Automation - 6,259 posts.
- Startup - 5,519 posts.
- SEO - 4,340 posts.

## Models
- Production sentiment model: vader (deploy-domain macro-F1 0.6493).
- Topic model: NMF, k=7, UMass coherence -1.0607 (more coherent than LDA).
